title: PH seeks purchase of 6 Chinook helicopters from US, eyes 2029 delivery

blocks.text: The Philippines is seeking to acquire six Boeing CH-47 Chinook heavy-lift helicopters from the United States through the $2-billion military financing package announced by US President Donald Trump, Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. said Thursday.
